rows.en:
(Yikes, just one minute till my next class!
I'd better hurry!)
Ah, sorry, Akimizu! Are you okay?

No, I'm the one who should be sorry!
I was rushing around way too much...
You didn't get hurt? You're okay?

Well, that's a reli...
Oh... Akimizu... your skirt...
rows.notes: Male. Cut off mid-word on purpose.

rows.en:
Huh? Hm?
KYAAAAAAAAH!!!!!

Did you see? You saw, didn't you?
Could you see anything?
It's fine, I only looked for a split second!
Ehhh~, so you DID see...

I barely saw anything!
More importantly, come on! We'll be late for class!

Oh!? That's right!
I have to hurry! Umm, see you!
Phew, guess I managed to smooth that over...
(Feels like I kinda got lucky there!)

(Aaah, one minute till my next class!
I've gotta hurry!)
Ah, sorry, Yuu! Are you okay?

Thank goodness~...
Oh... Yuu... your skirt...
It's fine, it only showed for a split second!
rows.notes: Female. Japanese: it was only visible briefly.

rows.en: Ehh... But I'm glad it wasn't a boy who saw...

Exactly, we're both girls, so it's no problem!
More importantly, come on! We'll be late for class!

Oh!? That's right!
I have to hurry! See you!
Well, at least it didn't turn into a big deal.

(So Yuu wears cute ones,
just like you'd expect from her looks...)
rows.notes: Female. Her underwear; the Japanese also only says 'cute ones'.

rows.en:
(Lunchtime already, huh. I'm starving...
What should I eat today... Tough call...)
(Oh, it's Akimizu. Maybe I'll ask her.)
Heyyy, Akimizu, got a sec?

Yeah, there's something I wanted to ask you.
This is out of nowhere, but what do you
feel like eating right now?

What I feel like eating right now?
Hmm~ let me see~...
Oh, you don't have to think that hard about it.

In that case~...
A strawberry pie piled high with strawberries!

Oh... I see...
That does sound tasty, but it's not
really lunch material...

...Oh!? Wait, that's what you meant?
Sorry for saying something weird...
rows.notes: Akimizu, both genders. She realizes he meant lunch.

rows.en: (Akimizu really does love sweets, huh...)

(Lunchtime already... I'm so hungry...
What should I eat today... I can't decide...)
(Oh, it's Yuu. Maybe I'll ask her.)
Hey, Yuu, got a sec?

Oh, \p-chan.
What is it?
rows.notes: Akimizu, female scenes (nml_yuu_009, 011). Matches male twin c11900.

rows.en:
Yeah, there's something I wanted to ask you.
This is out of nowhere, but what do you
feel like eating right now?
Oh, you don't have to think that hard.

Oh, um... I see...
That does sound yummy, but it's not
really lunch material, is it...
(Yuu really does love sweet stuff...)
(All right, nailed today's EX-Gear training too.)
\p-kun, great work out there!
Oh, Akimizu. What's up?

Your flying in class just now was amazing!
Being able to fly freely through the sky
must feel so good...

Yeah, it does feel good, sure...
But if everyone could fly freely,
that might be kind of a problem...
Huh!? Why's that?

The roads are jammed enough already.
We don't want traffic jams in the sky too, right?
Ahaha, that's true!

When that happens, I'm counting on you
to handle air traffic control, Akimizu.
rows.notes: Male. A joke: she is an operator.

rows.en: That sounds like a lot of work... but roger that!
rows.notes: Akimizu, both genders. Ryoukai shimashita, operator-style 'roger'.

rows.en:
(But if the sky really did jam up,
Akimizu would be in over her head...)
(All right, nailed today's EX-Gear training too!)
\p-chan, great work out there!
Oh, Yuu. What's up?

Yeah, it does feel good...
But if everyone could fly freely,
that might be kind of a problem...

When that happens, I'm counting on you
to handle air traffic control, Yuu.

(But if the sky really did jam up,
Yuu would probably be in over her head...)

(All right, another week's over!
What should I do this weekend?)

(Oh, it's Akimizu...
Okay, I'll ask about her weekend plans.)
Hey, Akimizu, got a sec?

Yeah, I just thought I'd ask what
you're doing this weekend...

Let's see...
Cleaning up... my room, I guess...
Huh, is your room that messy?

No, it's not like that. Um... well...
My st... uffed... mals...
rows.notes: Akimizu, both genders. She mumbles the word for stuffed animals in fragments.

rows.en: Huh? What?

Um... the stuffed animals... I collect...
there are just so many of them now...

Oh, so you're tidying those up...
...Wait, if it takes up your day off,
that's gotta be a whole lot of...

Huh!? N-no, there aren't... that many...
I... think...
Um, anyway, I'd better get going!
rows.notes: Akimizu, both genders. Konohen de: she cuts the talk short.

rows.en: (So Akimizu collects stuffed animals...)

(All right, another week done~
What should I do this weekend?)

(Oh, it's Yuu...
Okay, I'll ask about her weekend plans.)
Hey, Yuu, got a sec?

Yeah, I was just thinking I'd ask about
your weekend plans...
Ehh~, is your room messy? That's a surprise!

Oh, so you're tidying those up...
...Wait, if it takes up your day off,
that's gotta be a whole lot of...
(So Yuu collects stuffed animals...)
